title: Recovery Passport five-key gate
content: A proposed personnel charge is recoverable only when Evidence, Capacity, Eligibility, Budget and Approval all pass. One failed key blocks posting while the underlying cost remains visible.

title: Deterministic financial authority
content: Hours, payroll allocation, eligibility, formula results, posting status, Recovery Gate and voucher amounts must come from the embedded deterministic workbook engine rather than model invention.

title: AI role boundary
content: AI may suggest projects, classify activities, explain exceptions, detect unusual patterns, draft follow-ups and summarize risks. AI may not change hours, approve time, determine salary, override donor restrictions or authorize journal entries.

title: Learning from confirmed decisions
content: The application may learn from repeated human-confirmed activity coding decisions, but it must continue to show the suggestion and confidence instead of silently posting a learned code.

title: Unified Work-Evidence Spine
content: Master Time Schedule work sessions are the operational evidence layer. On completion, a valid session creates a DRAFT Recovery Passport time entry. The workbook engine remains authoritative for reconciliation, eligibility, allocation and posting controls; MTS performance analytics remain management information only.
